note: manual (Round 19): the moon-shaped canal before 出入贤良门 (S05 j80:9b 門前河形如月, its water from the west running east to the sluice at 如意门), traced on 4x crops of S01 between the two ink lines, 13-16 px apart (about 3 m); the channel runs on under the bridge on the axis (x 3298-3320) and under the plan's break east of it (x 3365-3379). Too narrow for the tracer: its two arms were land regions R2698 and R2782. Lined with white marble (Varin 1860, S245 pp.227-228).
